protocol: Integration and reuse example, not performance evidence. Identical to configs/examples/gaussian.json (same GARCH(1,1) Gaussian data-generating process and parameters, 3000 train and 1500 validation returns, seeds 6201/6202, W=1000, the six configured alpha levels, the same two baselines) with one addition: example_ewma_gaussian, the researcher-supplied fixed-decay (0.94) EWMA volatility with closed-form Gaussian VaR/ES and a 63-return warm-up. That model estimates no parameter, so it is not comparable on equal terms with a GARCH-t fitted on the train split. Test is not declared, so no held-out observation is simulated, fitted or scored.
